name: inverse leg curl with bench pads
description: A bodyweight hamstring curl where you lower your torso against the pads. It is very demanding for the back of the thighs.
instructions: Anchor your ankles under the bench pads and kneel upright.
Cross your arms or hold them in front of you.
Lean forward slowly from the knees, keeping hips and torso in a straight line.
Lower as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings.
